## About
Hon*Amotive is a car repair and maintenance shop on N Cave Creek Rd in north Phoenix. We specialize in Honda, Acura and all Japanese imports, and we think of ourselves as your dealership alternative in service and repair.
A car is an investment, and we help you protect it with honesty and integrity. Whether you need minor maintenance or major repairs, our certified technicians will make an accurate diagnosis and get the work done as quickly as they can. Mark Ottersberg owns the shop, and Don Costa is the manager.
Our customers have given us a 4.9 rating from 62 Google reviews. Call to book an appointment, Monday through Friday.

## Services
- Full Service Oil Change: We replace the oil and oil filter, then inspect the suspension, front brakes, air filter, hoses, belts and CV boots. We also look for oil leaks, check your fluid levels and tire condition, and set your tire pressures.
- Preventative maintenance: Full service oil changes, tune-ups, tire care, mileage checkups and more.
- Transmission Fluid Exchange: We recommend this on your car manufacturer's mileage schedule. Driving in stop and go traffic, in the mountains or in extreme heat can mean it's due sooner.
- Radiator Flush and Fill: We check the cooling system and find any leaks. Then we clear out rust, corrosion and old coolant and refill with the right mix of water and coolant.
- Bumper to bumper repairs: From minor maintenance to major repairs, we handle the work your car needs.

## FAQ
Q: What cars do you work on?
A: We specialize in Honda, Acura and all Japanese imports.

Q: Do you do body work?
A: No. We handle all major services, but we don't do body work.

Q: My car won't make it to the shop. What should I do?
A: Call R & W Towing. They already have an account with us, so getting your car here is easy.

Q: Can you help me find a used car?
A: Yes. Email us the make and model you're after, and we'll let you know what's on the market right now.
